description: Reduces a webpage to a structural skeleton. The web CLI detects sections and replaces content with semantic tokens (text, headings, images, CTAs, links, inputs), then the agent collapses repeated patterns and decorative wrappers and writes skeleton.html and manifest.json. Use when migrating a page to AEM Edge Delivery Services, extracting a page blueprint, or analyzing page structure for block generation.
